narration: The same money, a different life. The two lives ran as one for {identical_months} months, and in month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} parted first, in month {first_bar_apart_month}, with the ink barely dry. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, more of the ghost's salary was claimed the day it arrived, its Freedom {freedom_gap}.
